purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/handi-quilter-amara.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Handi Quilter Amara 20 product page (page modified 2026-10-01). Price range $12,995 to $27,990 depending on frame and Pro-Stitcher options.
Amara Specifications (one article for the Amara family; sewing opening shown as 228 x 521 mm, 9 x 20.5 in).

documents.type: user manual PDF (Amara 20+24, version 1.6, printed 07/10/24, 87 pages)
documents.note: Direct curl returns 403; text obtained through Firecrawl PDF parsing. Covers both 20 and 24 inch machines.
Handi Quilter Longarm Warranty (dated 08/26/10 on the page; downloadable 'longarm 2023' version not fetched). The same text also appears in the manual.
Amara ST: 20 in, stationary table, no Pro-Stitcher.

facts.value: 20 in of 'brightly-lit throat space' (product page); sewing opening 9 x 20.5 in / 228 x 521 mm (spec article and manual)
facts.note: The maker does not say needle to body. Its own measured figure is the 20.5 in sewing opening width, 0.5 in above the 20 in marketing figure; the 9 in is height. The manual states the same 9 x 20.5 in for the Amara 20 and 9 x 24.5 in for the Amara 24. Rule 11: 20 in qualifies as long-arm (18 in and up), on a frame.

site.label: Throat space
site.juki: 20 in of brightly-lit throat space; sewing opening 9 x 20.5 in

facts.value: 9 in
2,500 spm (manual mode 25 to 2,500 spm; regulated mode 0 spm to full speed)
facts.note: The page and the manual agree.

site.label: Max speed
site.juki: Stitching speeds up to 2,500 stitches per minute

facts.value: 4 to 24 spi (regulated)
Support article: 12/80 to 20/125. Manual v1.6: 80/12 to 130/21
facts.note: Page-vs-manual disagreement: the support article gives an upper size of 20/125, the current manual gives 130/21. Spec follows the support article. The manual's size list is the later document (printed 07/10/24) but the article is the Amara-specific web page; flag, do not resolve silently.

facts.value: Rotary horizontal axis hook, aluminum class M bobbin, bobbin case type MF; stand-alone bobbin winder
facts.spec_value: M class, high speed rotary hook; stand alone bobbin winder included

facts.value: 48 V brushless DC (spec article); 'Brushless DC' (manual); 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, 1.5 to 3.3 A; outlet power 120 W maximum
facts.spec_value: 48 V brushless DC; 120 W maximum outlet power
facts.note: The manual does not state 48 V; the support article does.

facts.value: HQ Studio3 frame 10 ft or 12 ft; the product page also lists the HQ Little Foot frame as a purchase option and says 'The Little Foot frame is compatible with the Amara 20'
facts.spec_value: HQ Studio3 frame, 10 ft or 12 ft, in the standard system
facts.note: Our spec names Studio3 only. The product page drop-down offers Studio3 10 ft, Studio3 12 ft and Little Foot; the description bullet says Studio3 included (10 or 12 ft). Editor to decide how to describe Little Foot. Frame dimensions in the product images, not parsed.

facts.value: 98 lbs (packaging weight, listed on the page)
facts.note: This is shipping weight of the packed machine head, not a stated machine weight. The manual says 'The Amara is heavy' and calls for two people to lift, with no figure. Machine weight remains unpublished; do not enter 98 as head weight.

facts.value: 40 x 16 x 28 in
facts.note: Packaging, not machine dimensions. Head dimensions not published.

facts.value: 7 in color touchscreen; Pro-Stitcher tablet can be used as the display instead
Menu-controlled QuiltMaster LED package: throat, needlebar, bobbin; needle laser
facts.spec_value: Menu controlled LED lighting at throat, needle bar and bobbin; needle laser

facts.value: QuiltMaster servo-controlled stitch regulation; manual and regulated modes; programmable handlebar buttons; automatic tie-offs
facts.spec_value: Built in (QuiltMaster servo controlled, Precision and Cruise modes)
facts.note: The product page and manual describe regulated and manual modes; the manual names the regulated modes Cruise and Precision, so the spec names are supported by the manual (the web page and specification article do not name them).

facts.value: Manual list: machine with carriage, front handlebars, front display, handlebar cable; 5 bobbins; bobbin case; needles 134 size 100/16 and 110/18 (packs of 10); thread tray and mast; EZ Pen Oiler; power cord; hex wrenches 2, 2.5, 3, 5 mm; screwdriver; open-toe Handi Foot (closed-toe installed); HQ Longarm Quilting Pins; decal sheet; quick reference card; HQ bobbin winder
facts.spec_value: Stand alone bobbin winder; handlebars; full accessory list not published
facts.note: The manual list is for the Amara 20 and 24 together. The frame is not in this list; frames are sold as a separate choice on the page.

facts.value: Pro-Stitcher Premium compatible; cabling pre-installed. Pro-Stitcher Premium listed at $12,995 on the maker's page
facts.note: Product page price range $12,995 to $27,990 (frame and Pro-Stitcher options). Not a dealer price.

facts.value: $12,995 to $27,990 range on the maker page (MSRP of options on the web store; dealers sell the machine)
facts.note: Page price range as shown 2026-10-02; the entry price matches the $12,995 in our spec. Handi Quilter points buyers to its retailer locator ('Find a Retailer'). The maker page also carries an Add to Cart button, so a direct web-store sale appears possible; ownership of the sale channel is not stated.

facts.value: Manual and web page: 90 days parts and labor; 10-year limited warranty on the sewing head casting or machining imperfections only (excludes mechanical and electrical parts); 5-year mechanical (free replacement parts, customer pays labor and shipping); 5-year electronic/electrical (same terms). Registration card must be received for warranty to be valid. Machines bought before 11-1-14 are on 2 years. Retailers may add their own warranty.
facts.spec_value: 10 yr casting, 5 yr electrical, 5 yr mechanical
facts.note: Applies to the 'HQ Quilting Machine' generally, not named for the Amara. Warranty page text is dated 08/26/10; a 'Longarm 2023' PDF is linked from the page and was not fetched. Labor and shipping are the customer's cost. The manual lists the warranty in a slightly different order but the same terms.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 10 yr casting, 5 yr mechanical, 5 yr electrical, 90 days parts and labor
site.others: Dealers repeat the 5 and 10 year figures

facts.value: Serviced and lubricated every 24 months or 10 million stitches, whichever comes first (spec article); annual service recommended from a representative (warranty page)
facts.note: Two maker documents give different service intervals (24 months vs annual). Needle every 2 to 4 hours and hook oiling every 3 to 4 hours per the warranty page.

facts.value: The maker page offers the machine for sale; no discontinuation notice on the page

'Everything you need for free-motion quilting right out of the box'; 'Pinpoint Needle Laser'; 'Easy-Set Tension'; 'QuiltMaster servo-controlled stitch regulation (perfect stitches, every time)'; 'Pro-Stitcher ready!'; 'brightly-lit throat space'
facts.note: Quoted as claims; 'perfect stitches, every time' is a maker claim, not a measured result.

facts.value: 24 in throat, sewing opening 9 x 24.5 in, HQ Gallery frame 10/12/15 ft; price range $19,995 to $33,990 on the maker page; maker says the Forte is now called the Amara 24 (quoted by an educator on the page)
facts.note: Same head features, 2,500 spm, 4 to 24 spi, 7 in display. Packaging weight 88 lbs, packaging 47 x 17 x 24 in.

facts.value: 20 in longarm on a stationary Lift Table or InSight Table; price $8,495 to $9,495; not Pro-Stitcher compatible; no handlebar item in its feature list
facts.note: Same family, sit-down table. Amazon's only Handi Quilter Amara result (ASIN B0BXB78N2J) is this ST, not the Amara 20.
